args.command: set -eu; mkdir -p '${FIXTURE_ROOT}'; printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > '${FIXTURE_ROOT}/audit.pdf'; printf '%s' 'iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mP8/x8AAusB9Wl2nfsAAAAASUVORK5CYII=' | base64 -d > '${FIXTURE_ROOT}/audit.png'; printf 'CATALOG_SHELL_OK\n'

set -eu; mkdir -p 'rag/inbox'; printf 'CATALOG_RAG_MARKER_%s
This deterministic document belongs only to the tool catalogue audit.
' '${RUN_ID}' > 'rag/inbox/catalog-e2e-${RUN_ID}.txt'; printf 'CATALOG_RAG_SETUP_OK
'
set -eu; if ollama list | awk 'NR > 1 { print $1 }' | grep -Fxq '${OLLAMA_AUDIT_MODEL}'; then present=true; else present=false; fi; printf 'CATALOG_OLLAMA_AUDIT_MODEL_PRESENT=%s\n' "$present"
set -eu; ollama cp '${OLLAMA_AUDIT_MODEL}' '${OLLAMA_DELETE_MODEL}'; ollama show '${OLLAMA_DELETE_MODEL}' >/dev/null; printf 'CATALOG_OLLAMA_ALIAS_OK\n'

set -eu; ollama rm '${OLLAMA_DELETE_MODEL}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if [ '${OLLAMA_AUDIT_MODEL_WAS_PRESENT}' = false ]; then ollama rm '${OLLAMA_AUDIT_MODEL}' >/dev/null; fi; printf 'CATALOG_OLLAMA_CLEANUP_OK\n'
set -eu; if apt-mark showhold | grep -Fxq bash; then held=true; else held=false; fi; printf 'CATALOG_BASH_WAS_HELD=%s\n' "$held"

set -eu; if docker image inspect '${DB_POSTGRES_IMAGE}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then pg=true; else pg=false; fi; if docker image inspect '${DB_MYSQL_IMAGE}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then mysql=true; else mysql=false; fi; if docker image inspect '${DB_MONGODB_IMAGE}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then mongo=true; else mongo=false; fi; printf 'CATALOG_DB_POSTGRES_IMAGE_PRESENT=%s
CATALOG_DB_MYSQL_IMAGE_PRESENT=%s
CATALOG_DB_MONGODB_IMAGE_PRESENT=%s
' "$pg" "$mysql" "$mongo"
set -eu; if [ '${PACKAGE_BASH_WAS_HELD}' = false ]; then apt-mark unhold bash >/dev/null; fi; printf 'CATALOG_PACKAGE_UNHOLD_OK\n'

set -eu; if [ -f .env ]; then cp .env '${FIXTURE_ROOT}/workspace.env.backup'; mode=restore; else mode=remove; fi; printf '
# catalog-e2e-${RUN_ID}
PUSHOVER_TOKEN=catalog-e2e-token
PUSHOVER_USER_KEY=catalog-e2e-user
PUSHOVER_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:${HTTP_FIXTURE_PORT}/1/messages.json
' >> .env; printf 'CATALOG_PUSHOVER_ENV_OK CATALOG_ENV_MODE=%s
' "$mode"

set -eu; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"; original=$(git branch --show-current); test -n "$original"; test "$original" != '${GIT_AUDIT_BRANCH}'; git show-ref --verify --quiet 'refs/heads/${GIT_AUDIT_BRANCH}' && git branch -D '${GIT_AUDIT_BRANCH}' || true; git checkout -b '${GIT_AUDIT_BRANCH}'; printf 'CATALOG_GIT_ORIGINAL=%s\n' "$original"

set -eu; remote_root="$(pwd)/${FIXTURE_ROOT}/remote.git"; git init --bare "$remote_root" >/dev/null; original=$(git remote get-url origin); git remote set-url origin "$remote_root"; printf 'CATALOG_GIT_ORIGINAL_REMOTE=%s\n' "$original"
set -eu; git branch --set-upstream-to='origin/${GIT_AUDIT_BRANCH}' '${GIT_AUDIT_BRANCH}'; printf 'CATALOG_GIT_TRACK_OK\n'
set -eu; git remote set-url origin '${GIT_ORIGINAL_REMOTE}'; git branch --unset-upstream 2>/dev/null || true; printf 'CATALOG_GIT_REMOTE_CLEANUP_OK\n'
set -eu; case '${PUSHOVER_ENV_CLEANUP_MODE}' in restore) cp '${FIXTURE_ROOT}/workspace.env.backup' .env ;; remove) rm -f .env ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac; printf 'CATALOG_PUSHOVER_ENV_CLEANUP_OK\n'
set -eu; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"; git checkout '${GIT_ORIGINAL_BRANCH}'; git branch -D '${GIT_AUDIT_BRANCH}'; printf 'CATALOG_GIT_CLEANUP_OK\n'

set -eu; python3 -c "import sqlite3; p='${FIXTURE_ROOT}/catalog.sqlite'; c=sqlite3.connect(p); c.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS catalog_e2e (marker TEXT NOT NULL)'); c.execute('DELETE FROM catalog_e2e'); c.execute('INSERT INTO catalog_e2e(marker) VALUES (?)', ('CATALOG_DB_SQLITE_OK',)); c.commit(); c.close()"; until docker exec '${DB_POSTGRES_CONTAINER}' pg_isready -U catalog -d catalog >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; docker exec '${DB_POSTGRES_CONTAINER}' psql -U catalog -d catalog -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS catalog_e2e (marker TEXT NOT NULL); TRUNCATE catalog_e2e; INSERT INTO catalog_e2e(marker) VALUES ('CATALOG_DB_POSTGRES_OK');" >/dev/null; until docker exec '${DB_MYSQL_CONTAINER}' mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -uroot -pcatalogroot --silent >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; docker exec '${DB_MYSQL_CONTAINER}' mysql -uroot -pcatalogroot catalog -e "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS catalog_e2e (marker VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL); TRUNCATE TABLE catalog_e2e; INSERT INTO catalog_e2e(marker) VALUES ('CATALOG_DB_MYSQL_OK');" >/dev/null; until docker exec '${DB_MONGODB_CONTAINER}' mongosh --quiet --eval "quit(db.adminCommand('ping').ok ? 0 : 1)" >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; docker exec '${DB_MONGODB_CONTAINER}' mongosh --quiet --eval "const c=db.getSiblingDB('catalog').catalog_e2e; c.deleteMany({}); c.insertOne({marker:'CATALOG_DB_MONGODB_OK'});" >/dev/null; printf 'CATALOG_DB_FIXTURES_OK\n'

set -eu; if [ '${DB_POSTGRES_IMAGE_WAS_PRESENT}' = false ]; then docker image rm '${DB_POSTGRES_IMAGE}' >/dev/null; fi; if [ '${DB_MYSQL_IMAGE_WAS_PRESENT}' = false ]; then docker image rm '${DB_MYSQL_IMAGE}' >/dev/null; fi; if [ '${DB_MONGODB_IMAGE_WAS_PRESENT}' = false ]; then docker image rm '${DB_MONGODB_IMAGE}' >/dev/null; fi; printf 'CATALOG_DB_IMAGE_CLEANUP_OK\n'
set -eu; rm -f 'rag/inbox/catalog-e2e-${RUN_ID}.txt'; rmdir 'rag/inbox' 'rag' 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf '${FIXTURE_ROOT}'; rm -f '${SCREENSHOT_FILE}'; printf 'CATALOG_CLEANUP_OK\n'

args.content:
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer import json import sys class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def do_GET(self): body = b"Catalog Audit

Catalog Audit

" self.send_response(200) self.send_header('Content-Type', 'text/html') self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body))) self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(body) def do_POST(self): length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', '0')) self.rfile.read(length) body = json.dumps({'status': 1, 'request': 'catalog-e2e'}).encode() self.send_response(200) self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json') self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body))) self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(body) def log_message(self, *_): pass print('CATALOG_PROCESS_OK', flush=True) ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', int(sys.argv[1])), Handler).serve_forever()

  audit:
    image: alpine:3.20
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo CATALOG_COMPOSE_OK; sleep 600"]

+++ b/${FIXTURE_ROOT}/audit.txt

-catalog marker edited
+catalog marker patched

args.command: printf 'CATALOG_CRON_OK\n' > '${FIXTURE_ROOT}/cron.txt'
printf 'CATALOG_SCHEDULE_OK\n' > '${FIXTURE_ROOT}/schedule.txt'
printf 'CATALOG_SCHEDULE_ADD_OK\n' > '${FIXTURE_ROOT}/schedule-add.txt'
printf 'CATALOG_SCHEDULE_ONCE_OK\n' > '${FIXTURE_ROOT}/schedule-once.txt'
python3 '${FIXTURE_ROOT}/audit_http.py' '${HTTP_FIXTURE_PORT}'
git daemon --reuseaddr --export-all --base-path="$(pwd)/${FIXTURE_ROOT}" --port='${GIT_DAEMON_PORT}' "$(pwd)/${FIXTURE_ROOT}/remote.git"
sleep 600
echo CATALOG_DOCKER_OK
sleep 600
sleep 600
printf 'CATALOG_HOST_OK\n'
sleep 1; printf 'CATALOG_HOST_SPAWN_OK\n'

set -eu; unit_dir="$HOME/.config/systemd/user"; mkdir -p "$unit_dir"; printf '%s
' '[Unit]' 'Description=LlamaFarm catalogue audit service' '[Service]' 'Type=simple' "ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'while :; do echo CATALOG_SERVICE_OK; sleep 2; done'" "ExecReload=/bin/sh -c 'echo CATALOG_SERVICE_RELOAD_OK'" '[Install]' 'WantedBy=default.target' > "$unit_dir/${SERVICE_UNIT}"; printf '%s
' '[Unit]' 'Description=LlamaFarm catalogue audit failed service' '[Service]' 'Type=oneshot' 'ExecStart=/bin/false' > "$unit_dir/${SERVICE_FAIL_UNIT}"; systemctl --user daemon-reload; printf 'CATALOG_SERVICE_FIXTURE_OK
'
systemctl --user start '${SERVICE_FAIL_UNIT}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || test "$(systemctl --user is-failed '${SERVICE_FAIL_UNIT}')" = failed; printf 'CATALOG_SERVICE_FAILED_STATE_OK\n'

set -eu; systemctl --user disable --now '${SERVICE_UNIT}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; systemctl --user reset-failed '${SERVICE_FAIL_UNIT}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/${SERVICE_UNIT}" "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/${SERVICE_FAIL_UNIT}"; systemctl --user daemon-reload; printf 'CATALOG_SERVICE_CLEANUP_OK\n'
